title: NAKED 100 E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill – Euro Gold
description:
Tobacco E-Liquid Euro Gold delivers the sensation and flavour of a lite cigarette’s tobacco. Enjoy the richness of smooth tobacco minus the post smell of an actual cigarette.
Naked 100 Euro Gold comes in 60ml bottle with 10ml space to add one nicotine shot for 3mg strength.
Naked 100 are manufactured in US California and they carry menthol fruit, tobacco and cream flavour with high VG concentration for premium quality eliquid.
Nicotine Level:
Zero – 0mg
VG/PG:
70% VG 30% PG
Bottle Size:
60ml filled with 50ml to add your nicotine shot.
